# Tanvi Bhatt - 'The Personal Branding Pioneer in India'

Speaking Coach to CEOs, Sharks & Thought Leaders | Keynote Speaker | India’s leading Authority on Personal Branding & Thought Leadership | Founder - SOMA, a Luxury Spiritual Wellness Brand | Consciousness Explorer

Mumbai Metropolitan Region (IN)

500 connections • 14,670 followers

## About

Tanvi is the founder of Tanvi Bhatt International - India's Premier Personal Branding Company; where she empowers leaders to become thought leaders & thought leaders to become ICONS. Known as 'The Personal Branding Pioneer in India', Tanvi is the go-to speaker on Personal Branding, Thought Leadership Development & Public Speaking in India. --As a Coach-- Tanvi helps aspiring thought leaders build a powerful and impactful personal brand that is built on her signature philosophy- Your Personal Brand is truly YOUnique mosaic of your spiritual thought leadership, your strategic thought leadership and your social media thought leadership in today’s digital world we live in! She helps YOU discover your brand’s core thought leadership-your BIG IDEA and build an impactful legacy around it that positions you as the category creator ‘Thought Leader’ of your industry! --As a Keynote Speaker— Tanvi has addressed over 100,000 leaders at over 400 events for global brands like LinkedIn, Deloitte, KPMG, Bank Of America, Pfizer, Capgemini, Infosys, Times Group, Mahindra Group, TATA Group, reliance to name a few. She has graced prestigious industry platforms like CII, FICCI, TiECON, DMAi, NHRDN, Social Media Week, PSAI, IITs & IIMs speaking to audience size from 100 to 1000 as a keynote speaker over the last 9 years. She’s also a 3X TED Speaker and has spoken on diverse themes around personal branding to karmic thought leadership to STAGEcraft of Public Speaking. --As an Author-- Tanvi is recognized as the ‘Personal Branding Expert’ for the CXOs by The Economic Times, where she shares her insights on all things personal branding under her weekly column ‘Brand YOU’. Her Columns and Articles are also featured in magazines like Inc. India, Entrepreneur, India Today, PITCH, Youth Inc. and Young, Fabulous & Self-Employed etc. --International Awards and Recognition— ✪ Best Young Woman Entrepreneur Award, Women Leaders in India Awards | 2013 ✪ The Iconic Stevie Award for Global Young Woman Entrepreneur in New York, USA | 2014 ✪ The TIAW World of Difference Award in Washington DC, USA | 2014 ✪ The Economic Times World HRD | 101 Most Fabulous Coaching Leaders of India | 2020

  > Most people think knowledge is power.
  >
  > I believe sharing wisdom from applied knowledge is the real power.
  >
  > Knowledge sitting in your notebook, your laptop or your mind enriches no one.
  >
  > But, knowledge in circulation creates industries and changes economies.
  >
  > Over the years of coaching founders, CEOs and thought leaders, I have realized that the most influential people are not necessarily those who know the most.
  >
  > They are the ones who contribute the most.
  >
  > Every lesson you have learnt through failure.
  >
  > Every insight you have earned through experience.
  >
  > Every breakthrough you have fought hard for.
  >
  > Every perspective that transformed your own thinking.
  >
  > None of these were given to you merely for your singular progress.
  >
  > These were entrusted to you to become someone else’s brand new beginning-someone’s north star!
  >
  > This is when Thought Leadership transcends Personal Branding.
  >
  > Once it stops asking,
  >
  > “How do I become more visible?”
  >
  > And starts asking,
  >
  > “How do I become more valuable?”
  >
  > Because every idea you generously share becomes your intellectual capital.
  >
  > Every perspective you articulate becomes part of your legacy.
  >
  > Every conversation you contribute to-leaves the world a little wiser than you found it.
  >
  > This is the fifth law of KARMAnomics:
  >
  > ILLUMINATE YOUR WORLD.
  >
  > Not because the world needs more content.
  >
  > But because it desperately needs more conscious contributors.
  >
  > People who choose to illuminate instead of impress.
  > To educate instead of merely engage.
  > To enrich the collective consciousness instead of chasing personal recognition.
  >
  > In this carousel, I explore why the highest purpose of Thought Leadership is not self-promotion.
  >
  > It is contribution to the collective.
  >
  > So let me ask you:
  >
  > What wisdom have you earned that someone else is still waiting to discover?
  >
  > And then ask yourself, “What am I really waiting for to step up and speak up…”
  >
  > #ThoughtLeadership #KARMAnomics #Knowledge #Power #IlluminateYourWorld
